Projectile motion: an analysis example

Examine horizontal and vertical motion in separate graphs.

Try this sample →

1. Detect the ball’s positions

Open the sample below and create a photo from 0.13 s to 0.73 s at 0.05-second intervals. Mark the ball’s center and select Detect all frames. Check that the detected points follow the center.

2. Choose axes and graphs

Set x horizontally and y upward. Use x–t for horizontal position, y–t for vertical position, and y–x for the trajectory.

3. Compare fits

Choose a linear fit for x–t and a quadratic fit for y–t. In y(t) = a + bt + ct², acceleration is 2c. With meter calibration and correct recording times, its unit is m/s². For ideal motion under gravity alone, upward-positive vertical acceleration is −g.
